description: Source code for Unicode precomposition and filename encoding handling on MacOS X, including functions for path processing, directory reading, and string re-encoding using iconv.

methods.name: has_non_ascii
methods.description: Checks if a string contains non-ASCII characters and counts the length.

methods.name: probe_utf8_pathname_composition
methods.description: Detects and sets Unicode precomposition support based on filesystem tests.

methods.name: precompose_string_if_needed
methods.description: Converts a string to precomposed Unicode if needed, using iconv.

methods.name: precompose_argv_prefix
methods.description: Preprocesses command-line arguments and prefix for Unicode normalization.

methods.name: precompose_utf8_opendir
methods.description: Opens a directory with Unicode precomposition support.

methods.name: precompose_utf8_readdir
methods.description: Reads directory entries with Unicode precomposition conversion.

methods.name: precompose_utf8_closedir
methods.description: Closes a directory opened with Unicode precomposition support.
